rules: Validate against the exact protocol version before normalization.
Retain raw value, source identity and order update context.
No mission completion inferred solely from empty node/edge arrays.
No mechanical conversion of robot operating mode into MachineryOperationMode.

entries.transform: Keep composite robot identity and update number; correlate separately with mission ID.
Retain order scope, sequence and release information.
Preserve source enum; never collapse to machinery activity mode.
Independent freshness policy; ONLINE is not operational readiness.
Retain MANUAL/REMOTE/NONE verbatim in value; telemetry only, not a safe-state claim.
